items.program_name: 雇用創出税額控除(OH JCTC)
items.summary: オハイオ州税額控除機関(Ohio Tax Credit Authority)が、Strongsville市のArk Transportation, Delivered Inc., Verootに対し8年間1.767%の雇用創出税額控除(JCTC)を承認。103人の新規雇用と年間$8.8Mの新規給与創出を約束。
items.infer: 受領者名(Transportation/Delivered)から物流・配送関連事業者と推測され、拠点拡張に伴う設備投資が発生する可能性(推論)。
items.verbatim: Ohio Tax Credit Authority approved a tax exemption (Data Center Sales Tax Exemption or JCTC-type exemption) of 1.767% for 8 years on 2024-02-26 for a project in the City of Strongsville, Cuyahoga County. Commitment: create 103 full-time equivalent employees generating $8,800,000 in new annual payrol
